interfaces.writer: tools.bridge_approval_carry_forward:derive_live_carry_forward (live factory; its receipt comes from evaluate_approval_carry_forward)
interfaces.consumer: tools.bridge_approval_carry_forward:verify_carry_forward_receipt(receipt, evidence) -> bool, the published re-verification the gate runs against the current ledger
interfaces.gate_apply: tools.idle_consensus_auto_merge:evaluate_auto_merge_gate(carry_forward=..., apply=True): published, refuses until the semantic receipt consumer exists (intentionally unavailable)
interfaces.merge_apply: tools.merge_with_bridge_receipt:merge_with_bridge_receipt: no carry input published (RED missing API, intentionally unavailable)
interfaces.magma_writer: tools.write_bridge_consensus_merge_receipt:write_bridge_consensus_merge_receipt: no carry receipt input published (RED missing API; Tools is wiring the actual writer)

canonical_digest: sha256 of json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) as published for receipt digests
reseal: an attacker able to write the receipt recomputes every receipt-internal digest (approval_event_sha256 list, original_approval_basis_sha256, content-identity mirrors) so the forged receipt is self-consistent; only re-derivation from the ledger, git and CI can refuse it

classes.extra_authority: additional authority beyond the derived receipt
classes.type_alias: JSON value of another type that compares equal in Python
classes.append: events appended to the ledger after the receipt
classes.stale: CI or queue observation no longer current
classes.magma_payload: MAGMA payload field outside the approval receipt, resealed through the writer's bundle step

control_reseal_is_faithful.note: resealing an unmodified receipt changes nothing

control_json_roundtrip.note: a persisted and reloaded receipt still verifies

resealed_forged_author_waiver.note: drop the lead vote and claim a waiver

evidence_rco_subset_hides_later_veto.note: caller supplies only claude-rco-1 as recognized RCO while claude-rco-2 vetoes later

append_harmless_rco_diagnostic.note: recognized RCO message, informational status, names the approved head

append_rco_pass_after_own_veto.note: a later RCO pass is not a retraction of the same RCO veto

append_rco_bound_pass_after_own_veto.note: the same RCO re-posts a fully basis-bound pass at the approved head after its own objection; the refusal must come from the surviving objection, not from a missing basis

prefix_truncated_harmless_tail.note: by published design: only material basis and controls must lie inside the prefix; the entire current ledger is re-derived, so dropping a harmless tail grants nothing

apply_gate_refuses_carry_apply.note: published; until a032f622 refused as intentionally unavailable; from 211490de carry apply is published and a placeholder path without a MAGMA carry receipt must still refuse with no merge

apply_merge_carry_input.note: published at 211490de (carry_forward); driven end to end by test_consensus_carry_forward_apply_executors.py

apply_magma_writer_carry_input.note: published at a032f622 (carry_forward); the verdict cases run through it in the magma route

magma_payload_review_origin_base_to_live.note: review_origin basis base_sha set to the live base

magma_payload_ci_evidence_run_conclusion.note: ci_evidence run conclusion SUCCESS instead of success

reason_rule: for cases with a reason, the published evaluator must refuse the current evidence for that reason; for prefix cases the evaluator must still carry, so only the receipt prefix check refuses

magma_route.consumer: tools.write_bridge_consensus_merge_receipt:verify_carry_forward_merge_receipt (MAGMA files, then verify_live_carry_forward_receipt and the historical report rederivation)

route_meaning.receipt: writer emits the legit bundle; the attacker mutates payload carry_forward.approval_receipt with the same mutation as the direct route and reseals the MAGMA bundle; consumer verdict
route_meaning.payload: writer emits the legit bundle; the attacker mutates a payload field and reseals; consumer verdict
route_meaning.ledger: the change is applied to the ledger before a writer run (writer verdict) and after a legit writer run (consumer verdict)
route_meaning.ledger_after: the ledger is rewritten after a legit writer run (reorder or insert inside the bound prefix); consumer verdict
route_meaning.env: CI or queue observation changed before a writer run with a stale caller snapshot (writer verdict) and after a legit writer run (consumer verdict)
route_meaning.tail: writer runs with a harmless tail event; the attacker truncates the receipt prefix by one and reseals; consumer verdict
